title: Fleet Comeback Declined-Work Share — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders commercial fleet account (Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Net 30), the declined-work share of a comeback credit follows the original repair order's declined estimate decisions:
- where the original repair order carries a declined estimate decision for at least 500.00, the credit is multiplied by 0.85;
- where it carries one or more declined estimate decisions and every one of them is for less than 500.00, by 0.9;
- otherwise it is not reduced.

Every declined decision recorded on the original repair order counts, on any of its concern lines.

| Declined decisions on the original repair order | Multiplied by |
|---|---|
| One for 500.00 or more (with or without smaller ones) | 0.85 |
| Only ones below 500.00 | 0.9 |
| None | not reduced |

**Edges (hypothetical).** A declined decision of 500.00 gives 0.85; one of 499.99 gives 0.9.
